entities.summary: Jacqueline Layne Coleman is an American educator and politician serving as the 58th lieutenant governor of Kentucky since 2019. She has worked as a high school administrator, teacher, and basketball coach. Coleman is the founder and president of Lead Kentucky, a nonprofit organization focused on education policy reform. She is a member of the Democratic Party. Jacqueline Coleman was a writers & intellectuals from Danville (b. 1982-06-09, Danville). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
